purpose: Numerical precision checks conditional on fixed site estimates and variances, using the normal working model with a reference measure flat in the mean and standard deviation.

monte_carlo.precision_rule: Report one-SE and 3.5-SE intervals (quantiles use exact-binomial rank interval); a deterministic discrepancy is evaluated on the exact legacy sampler law, never inferred from a single Monte Carlo realization. Finite-draw deviations exceeding reporting tolerance are precision limitations, not automatic evidence of grid bias.

selected_simulation_checks.type: six fresh fixed-seed Gaussian boundary examples, not reproduction of the full simulation

interpretation: Tolerances are numerical/reporting criteria, not scientific effect thresholds or frequentist coverage claims. I/Sbar and probability targets support two-decimal reporting; H supports three decimals; Jeff supports one decimal, with a safety margin. Ea is monitored separately because unbounded moments can be more tail-sensitive than bounded diagnostics.
deterministic_comparison_rule: Flag exact 250-node grid/jitter results that differ from the untruncated reference by more than a reporting tolerance. Export quadrature summaries regardless of whether discrepancies arise from grid approximation or finite posterior draws. The model, prior, supplied site estimates and variances, and causal target are unchanged.
